brief: 6 kitchen tools that replaced 30 — minimalist home cook edition.

slots.headline: Too Many Tools?
slots.subtitle: Six swaps that cleared my counters and my head.

slots.title: One Chef's Knife
slots.body: A single sharp blade handles slicing, dicing, mincing, and even peeling. Ditch the block, scissors, and gadgets. One knife, zero clutter.

slots.title: Cast Iron Skillet
slots.body: Sear, bake, roast, and grill in one pan. It replaces nonstick, grill pans, and roasting dishes. Oven-safe and built to last.

slots.title: Heavy Dutch Oven
slots.body: Braise stews, bake bread, cook rice, and slow-cook meals. One pot takes over for the slow cooker, rice maker, and stockpot.

slots.title: Box Grater Only
slots.body: Zest citrus, shred cheese, slice veggies, and mince garlic. No need for separate zesters, presses, or mandolines. Four sides, endless jobs.

slots.title: One Immersion Blender
slots.body: Blend soups, whip cream, chop herbs, and froth milk directly in the pot. It replaces the blender, processor, and whisk.

slots.title: Half Sheet Pan
slots.body: Roast proteins, bake cookies, crisp pizza, and catch drips. One rimmed pan covers roasting pans, baking trays, and pizza stones.
